propositions: The generic reads-under-contention property accepts shape-valid but content-hollow payloads (empty object on show, records missing ticket_id on list/search/ready) as passing when they should fail.

Seeded faults F3 (show emits {}, exit 0) and F6 (show emits record without ticket_id, exit 0) pass the generic tests but fail the original regression test, exposing a gap between docstring and intent.
The _assert_complete_or_loud assertion currently stops at isinstance check for shape validation and does not enforce content completeness (truthy ticket_id presence) on any of the four surfaces.
Per-surface content-completeness predicates must be added to the SURFACES table and enforced in _assert_complete_or_loud to detect truncated or hollow payloads that exit cleanly.
